answer: Rotate epoch keys under quorum co-signature: each agent derives a fresh cipher every epoch, and the new key only counts once k established peers from distinct cohorts co-sign the rotation. No identity survives an epoch unproven, so a sybil farm of M fakes must repurchase k attestations for all M keys every epoch - recurring cost M*k*fee - while honest agents co-sign once. Trust reaches its zenith when cohorts overlap across the mesa of past rotations, making bulk forgery unprofitable at any scale.
